meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every character, outfit, prop and background rule. Every image prompt must be built from this file so the look never drifts.
meta.reference_image_rule: ALWAYS attach the character/style reference image (Sam turnaround sheet + one approved scene still) to EVERY generation. Text alone is not enough to lock the look.
meta.how_to_extend: Add new characters under `characters` using the exact same keys. Never edit `global_art_style` per-scene; scene-level variation lives only in the scene spec.
changelog: 1.1.0: per owner direction, faces now have white eyes with black pupils and a small simple nose; added the adult Sam variant (late 20s) used in EP01.

global_art_style.style_summary: Hand-inked 2D editorial cartoon illustration: minimalist stick-limb characters with large cream-white rounded heads and simple flat-colored outfits, placed inside richly detailed, semi-realistic, warm vintage illustrated environments. Looks like a premium animated history/finance explainer still frame.

line_work.character_outline: Bold, uniform, clean black ink outline around head, outfit, hat and hands (approx. 6-8 px at 1920x1080). Smooth vector-like curves, no sketchy double lines.
line_work.stick_limbs: Arms and legs are single solid black lines of the same thick weight as the outline (approx. 6-8 px), slightly curved, no muscles, no elbows/knees drawn, no thickness taper.
line_work.background_lines: Thinner dark-brown/sepia ink lines (approx. 2-4 px) with subtle crosshatching and light texture in shadows. Backgrounds always have visibly thinner lines than characters so characters pop.
line_work.line_color: Near-black (#1A1612) for characters; dark sepia brown (#3B2A1C) for environments.

palette_rules: Overall scene is warm, sepia-leaning, earthy: tan, cream, wood brown, muted olive, soft amber light.
Use at most ONE high-contrast accent color per scene (vivid green arrow/number, red SOLD stamp, red crayon scribbles, gold seal) to direct the eye to the financial point.
No neon, no cyberpunk, no saturated rainbow palettes, no cold blue-dominant grading (except a deliberate 'modern' panel in a split-screen, which uses clean off-white #FAFAF7).

shading_rules: Characters: flat color fills only. Faces have ZERO shading, zero blush, zero gradients. Outfits may have one very subtle flat shadow tone at most.
Backgrounds: soft warm ambient lighting, gentle gradients from lamp/window light, light ink crosshatching in corners and under furniture, soft cast shadow ellipse under each character's feet.
Light sources are motivated and visible where possible: oil lamp, table lamp, hanging pendant lamps, tall windows with warm daylight.

character_anatomy_rules.proportions: Head is very large: roughly 1/3 of total character height. Body/torso is a simple outfit shape (vest, dress, suit jacket) roughly the same height as the head. Legs are stick lines making up the remaining third.
character_anatomy_rules.head: Smooth, slightly wide rounded oval, flat cream-white (#F7F3EA), bold black outline. Small cream ears at the sides (may hide under hair or a hat). Small stroke nose. Short neck hidden by the collar.
character_anatomy_rules.torso: Clean outfit block with flat colors and bold outline; collar visible where specified. No chest/abdomen anatomy, no shoulders muscles.
character_anatomy_rules.arms: Single thick black stick lines emerging from the outfit's shoulders, smooth bends, no elbows.
character_anatomy_rules.hands: Rounded white (or black, if specified for a character) mitten/glove hands with a bold outline: 3-4 stubby rounded fingers suggested, thumb clearly separate. Hands are slightly oversized relative to stick arms.
character_anatomy_rules.legs: Single thick black stick lines emerging from shorts/skirt/trouser hem; trousers, if worn, cover the upper legs as a simple flat shape and the stick continues below.
character_anatomy_rules.feet: Simple dark charcoal (#2B2826) rounded oval/bean shoes with bold outline, no laces, no soles detail.
character_anatomy_rules.pose_language: Clear, readable silhouettes; strong gesture lines (pointing, presenting, crossed arms, clapping, stamping). Limbs never tangled or hidden.

facial_expression_rules.eyes: White oval eyes with a bold black outline, a solid black pupil and a tiny white highlight. Upper-lid line drops over the eye for smug/skeptical/serious. Shocked: bigger eyes, smaller pupils. Blink = a short curved line.
facial_expression_rules.eyebrows: Thick, short, solid black strokes doing ~80% of the acting: angled down-in for smug/determined/annoyed, raised high and curved for surprised, tilted up-in for worried.
facial_expression_rules.mouth: Single clean black line or simple open shape: wide grin with a white teeth band for happy, one-sided smirk for smug, small 'o' for shocked, flat/wavy line for worried/serious, downturned short line for annoyed.
facial_expression_rules.forbidden: No realistic noses (only the small stroke nose), no cheek shading, no wrinkles, no lips, no detailed teeth (a flat white band is fine), no realistic skin, no blush stickers, no anime sparkle eyes.
facial_expression_rules.nose: Small, clean single-stroke nose: a short curved hook just below and between the eyes. No nostrils, no shading.

background_rules: Environments are richly detailed, semi-realistic 2D illustrations: wood paneling, wallpaper patterns, plank floors, period furniture, ticker tape machines, rotary/candlestick telephones, oil lamps, chalkboards, framed photos, rugs, tall multi-pane windows with soft city silhouettes.
Era default: 1920s-1940s American small town / early Wall Street, unless a scene explicitly says 'modern'.
Perspective: gentle one-point perspective with a clear center stage for the main character.
Background characters (crowds, brokers, clerks) use the SAME stick-limb + cream-head anatomy, but simpler expressions and muted outfit colors so the hero stands out.

All in-image text (signs, chalkboards, price boards, certificates, tags) must be short, legible, correctly spelled, in clean serif or hand-chalk lettering. Only render the exact text given in the scene spec; anything else is unreadable squiggle lines.
Leave 10-15% safe margin around the action so the editor can zoom/pan (Ken Burns) without cropping heads or key text.

framing_and_output.composition: Hero character readable at thumbnail size; key prop/text in the upper or center third; clean negative space for caption overlays.

camera_framings.wide_establishing: Full room visible, hero small-to-medium in center foreground, lots of environmental storytelling.
camera_framings.medium: Hero from head to feet filling ~55-65% of frame height, key prop and one supporting character visible.
camera_framings.medium_close: Hero from waist up, head large in frame, key prop held toward camera.
camera_framings.close_up_prop: Prop (certificate, ledger, price tag) fills frame; hero peeks from behind/above it.
camera_framings.over_the_shoulder: Foreground supporting character partially in frame (back of head/hat), hero facing camera.
camera_framings.split_screen: Two equal vertical panels separated by a clean thick black divider line; each panel a complete composition.

negative_prompt: NO muscular or realistic human bodies
NO gradients or shading on faces
NO picture-in-picture or thumbnail inset in the corner
NO random gibberish text where readable text was requested
NO extra characters beyond those specified (except an explicitly requested background crowd)
anti_drift_rules: Character heads must remain flat cream-white with black outline in every shot.
Limbs are ALWAYS single thick black stick lines; if a generation gives fleshy arms or legs, reject it.
Outfit colors and props are LOCKED per character (see `characters`). Never swap Sam's olive vest, white collar, charcoal newsboy cap, brown shorts or beige satchel.
Background detail goes UP, character detail stays DOWN. This contrast is the signature look.
If the model drifts, re-generate with the reference image attached and the full negative prompt; do not 'fix' with new style words.

sam.role: Main character / hero. A sharp, ambitious young kid (approx. 11-13 years old in look) learning money the hard way in a vintage 1920s-1940s world. Narrator's avatar for every lesson.
sam.head_shape: Large smooth rounded oval, slightly wider than tall, flat cream-white #F7F3EA with bold black outline. Visible brown hair tufts only at the forehead fringe and above each ear beneath the cap.
sam.face_style: White oval eyes with black pupils and a tiny highlight, set wide apart; thick short black eyebrows; a small single-stroke nose; a clean mouth that opens to a dark interior with a white teeth band when happy. No blush, no freckles.
sam.hair_or_hat: Charcoal-gray/brown newsboy (flat) cap #4A4440 with a small round button on top, soft puffy crown, short curved brim pointing forward, bold outline. Short medium-brown hair #7A4E2D peeking out as 3-4 pointed bangs on the forehead and small tufts at the sides. The cap is NEVER removed.
sam.torso_outfit: Muted olive-green knit sweater vest #6E7A45 (V-neck) over a white collared shirt with a crisp pointed collar visible at the neck; white shirt sleeves are NOT shown (arms are stick lines from the vest armholes). Short medium-brown shorts #6B5136 ending just above the knees.
sam.limb_style: Single thick black stick arms and legs, smooth curves, no elbows/knees, same weight as outline.
sam.hands_and_feet: White rounded mitten hands with bold black outline and a separated thumb. Dark charcoal rounded bean-shaped shoes.
signature_props: Beige/khaki canvas messenger satchel #C9B48C worn cross-body: strap runs from his right shoulder to the bag on his left hip (ALWAYS present)
Small brown leather coin purse with a clasp (when buying)
Pencil and a small ledger notebook (when planning/calculating)
Stacks of coins, stock certificates, paper bills (scene-dependent)

allowed_expressions.happy: Eyebrows relaxed and slightly raised, wide open grin with a white upper-teeth band, eyes solid dots.
allowed_expressions.smug_confident: Eyebrows angled sharply down toward the center, one-sided smirk curling up on one side, dot eyes. His signature look.
allowed_expressions.shocked_surprised: Eyebrows raised high and arched, eyes become small white circles with black outline and tiny pupils (or star sparkles for awe), small round 'o' mouth.
allowed_expressions.confused_skeptical: One eyebrow raised, the other flat/lowered, mouth a short slanted line pushed to one side.
allowed_expressions.worried_stressed: Eyebrows tilted up toward the center, wavy thin mouth line, optional single small sweat drop beside the head.
allowed_expressions.serious_determined: Eyebrows flat and slightly lowered, mouth a short straight line, dot eyes looking directly forward.

do_not: Do not remove the cap
Do not change the vest color
Do not give him long pants
Do not drop the satchel
Do not age him into a teen/adult body
Do not add freckles or a realistic nose

sam_adult.role: Main character as a young adult (late 20s): the big brother who explains money to his 15-16 year old little brother (the viewer). Used from EP01 on.
sam_adult.head_shape: Large smooth rounded oval, slightly wider than tall, flat cream-white #F7F3EA with bold black outline; about 1/3.5 of total height (adult proportions: taller torso and legs than kid Sam). Small cream ears at the sides.
sam_adult.face_style: White oval eyes with black pupils and a tiny highlight, set wide apart; thick short black eyebrows; a small single-stroke nose; a clean mouth that opens to a dark interior with a white teeth band when happy. No blush, no freckles.
sam_adult.hair_or_hat: Charcoal-gray/brown newsboy (flat) cap #4A4440 with a small round button on top, soft puffy crown, short curved brim pointing forward, bold outline. Short medium-brown hair #7A4E2D peeking out as 3-4 pointed bangs on the forehead and small tufts at the sides. The cap is NEVER removed.
sam_adult.torso_outfit: Same muted olive-green V-neck knit sweater vest #6E7A45 over a white shirt with crisp pointed collar; long medium-brown trousers #6B5136 with a dark belt and small brass buckle. Trousers cover the thighs as flat thick shapes; the lower legs continue as single black stick lines.
sam_adult.limb_style: Single thick black stick arms and legs, smooth curves, no elbows/knees, same weight as outline.
sam_adult.hands_and_feet: White rounded mitten hands with bold black outline and a separated thumb. Dark charcoal rounded bean-shaped shoes.
signature_props: Beige/khaki canvas messenger satchel #C9B48C worn cross-body: strap from his right shoulder to the bag on his left hip (ALWAYS present)
Pointing finger mitten for explaining at the chalkboard

allowed_expressions.happy: Eyebrows relaxed and slightly raised, wide open grin with a white upper-teeth band, eyes solid dots.
allowed_expressions.smug_confident: Eyebrows angled sharply down toward the center, one-sided smirk curling up on one side, dot eyes. His signature look.
allowed_expressions.shocked_surprised: Eyebrows raised high and arched, eyes become small white circles with black outline and tiny pupils (or star sparkles for awe), small round 'o' mouth.
allowed_expressions.confused_skeptical: One eyebrow raised, the other flat/lowered, mouth a short slanted line pushed to one side.
allowed_expressions.worried_stressed: Eyebrows tilted up toward the center, wavy thin mouth line, optional single small sweat drop beside the head.
allowed_expressions.serious_determined: Eyebrows flat and slightly lowered, mouth a short straight line, dot eyes looking directly forward.
allowed_expressions.neutral: Relaxed brows, eyes open with a slight lid, small friendly closed smile.

do_not: Do not remove the cap
Do not change the vest color
Do not give him shorts (adult wears long trousers)
Do not drop the satchel
Do not add a beard or stubble
Do not add freckles or a realistic nose

lena.role: Skeptical family member. Voice of doubt — 'that's a waste of money' — the person Sam has to prove wrong.
lena.head_shape: Large rounded oval, flat cream-white #F7F3EA, bold black outline, same proportions as Sam.
lena.face_style: Solid black dot eyes, thick expressive black eyebrows, single-line mouth. Default heavy-lidded, unimpressed look.
lena.hair_or_hat: Medium-brown hair #7A4E2D with a center part, two long braided pigtails falling to the shoulders, each tied with a small dark-brown bow.
lena.torso_outfit: Knee-length A-line dress in warm tan #CDB287 with a small darker brown floral/damask repeating pattern, white rounded Peter Pan collar, small dark buttons down the front placket, short puffed sleeves.
lena.limb_style: Single thick black stick arms and legs, smooth, no elbows/knees.
lena.hands_and_feet: White rounded mitten hands. Dark charcoal rounded bean shoes.
signature_props: Arms crossed tightly as default pose
Occasionally a small coin jar or a newspaper

allowed_expressions.annoyed_skeptical: Eyebrows angled sharply down and in, heavy upper-lid line over dot eyes, short downturned mouth. Default.
allowed_expressions.unimpressed: Flat eyebrows, half-lidded eyes, flat straight mouth.
allowed_expressions.surprised: Eyebrows shoot up, white circle eyes, small 'o' mouth.
allowed_expressions.grudging_smile: One eyebrow still lowered, small reluctant smile on one side.
allowed_expressions.worried: Eyebrows tilted up toward center, wavy mouth.

do_not: No makeup
No adult proportions
Do not change dress pattern or color
Do not unbraid the hair

mr_hale_shopkeeper.role: Kind but shrewd general-store / grocery shopkeeper who sells to Sam and occasionally buys from him.
mr_hale_shopkeeper.head_shape: Large rounded oval, flat cream-white #F7F3EA, bold outline, slightly rounder/wider than Sam's.
mr_hale_shopkeeper.face_style: Solid black dot eyes, thick bushy black-gray eyebrows, a thick neat gray handlebar mustache #6D6D6D (the ONLY facial hair allowed in the cast), single-line mouth under it.
mr_hale_shopkeeper.hair_or_hat: Bald top with short gray hair on the sides; small gray tufts above the ears.
mr_hale_shopkeeper.torso_outfit: White long-sleeve-implied shirt with dark-gray sleeve garters, a muted brown waistcoat #6B5136, and a long cream-white apron #F2EBDD tied at the waist covering down to the knees. Dark brown trousers.
mr_hale_shopkeeper.limb_style: Single thick black stick arms and legs (legs mostly hidden by apron and counter).
mr_hale_shopkeeper.hands_and_feet: White rounded mitten hands. Dark charcoal bean shoes.
signature_props: Glass candy jars on the counter

allowed_expressions.friendly: Relaxed eyebrows, smile curving under the mustache.
allowed_expressions.shrewd: One eyebrow lowered, small knowing smile.
allowed_expressions.surprised: Eyebrows up, white circle eyes, 'o' mouth under mustache.
allowed_expressions.doubtful: Eyebrows pinched, mouth flat under mustache.

do_not: No beard
Do not remove the apron
No modern clothing

mr_vance_mentor.role: Wealthy, calm banker/executive mentor who explains the math of profit, compounding and risk. Also usable as the 'modern rich guy' in split-screens.
mr_vance_mentor.head_shape: Large rounded oval, flat cream-white #F7F3EA, bold outline, same scale as other adults.
mr_vance_mentor.face_style: Solid black dot eyes, thick straight black eyebrows, single-line mouth. Default calm, composed expression.
mr_vance_mentor.hair_or_hat: Short, neat, glossy black hair #1E1E1E with a side part and a smooth helmet-like shape on top of the head. Optional dark charcoal fedora when outdoors.
mr_vance_mentor.torso_outfit: Dark charcoal-gray three-piece suit #3E3E42: jacket, buttoned waistcoat with three small buttons, white dress shirt, solid red necktie #B3261E. Matching charcoal trousers.
mr_vance_mentor.limb_style: Single thick black stick arms and legs.
mr_vance_mentor.hands_and_feet: BLACK rounded glove/mitten hands (his distinctive trait vs. other characters' white hands). Black rounded bean shoes.
signature_props: Pocket watch on a gold chain

allowed_expressions.calm_neutral: Straight eyebrows, dot eyes, short straight mouth. Default.
allowed_expressions.approving: Eyebrows slightly raised, small closed smile.
allowed_expressions.serious_warning: Eyebrows lowered and pinched, flat mouth.
allowed_expressions.deadpan: Flat eyebrows, blank dot eyes, tiny flat mouth (for comedic 'regressed' beats).

do_not: No beard or stubble
Do not switch tie color
Do not give him white hands

brokers_ensemble.role: Background crowd for exchanges, brokerages, banks and auctions. Reacting, clapping, phoning, reading tape.
brokers_ensemble.head_shape: Large rounded oval, flat cream-white #F7F3EA, bold outline.
brokers_ensemble.face_style: Solid dot eyes, short eyebrows, simple mouth. Many are faceless-from-behind or 3/4 view. Expressions muted.
brokers_ensemble.hair_or_hat: Mostly dark gray, brown or charcoal fedoras with a darker hatband; some bare-headed clerks with neat dark hair; some wear green-tinted visors.
brokers_ensemble.torso_outfit: Muted long overcoats (charcoal, taupe #8C7A62, brown) over suits with ties; clerks wear vests over white shirts with sleeve garters.
brokers_ensemble.limb_style: Single thick black stick arms and legs.
brokers_ensemble.hands_and_feet: White rounded mitten hands. Dark bean shoes.

allowed_expressions.busy_focused: Slightly lowered brows, flat mouth, looking at papers/phone.

do_not: Never more saturated than the hero
Never more detailed faces than the hero

settings_library.front_porch: Vintage small-town wooden front porch: painted clapboard house siding, screen door, porch steps, a milk crate, a hanging porch lamp, potted plants, a tree-lined dirt street in soft afternoon light.
settings_library.family_living_room: Cozy 1940s living room: damask/floral warm-brown wallpaper, dark wood wainscoting, framed sepia family portrait on the wall, wooden side table with a vintage tube radio and a glowing fabric-shade table lamp, floral upholstered armchair, patterned red-brown rug on plank floor, warm amber lamplight.
settings_library.general_store: 1930s general store / grocery: long dark-wood counter with a brass cash register, glass candy jars, shelves of tins, sacks of flour and burlap bags, hanging scale, chalkboard daily prices sign, front window with painted lettering seen in reverse, warm daylight.
settings_library.brokerage_office: Small-town 1920s brokerage office: big wood-framed chalkboard 'PRICE BOARD' with handwritten names and prices, hanging green/brass pendant lamps, ticker tape machine with curling tape, wooden desks with cash registers and ink wells, cork boards with pinned notices, pendulum wall clock, warm golden light.
settings_library.stock_exchange_floor: Bustling 1920s stock exchange trading room: huge chalkboard covering the back wall with columns of tickers, prices and red/green changes, clerk on a wooden ladder updating prices, rows of wooden desks with candlestick phones and stacks of paper, a glass-dome ticker tape machine spilling tape into a wicker basket, tall multi-pane windows with city skyline silhouettes.
settings_library.bedroom_study_desk: Sam's humble bedroom corner: small rough wooden desk and chair, oil lamp with glowing flame, a wall calendar hanging on a nail, plain warm-tan plaster wall, worn wooden floor.
settings_library.bank_office_chalkboard: Wood-paneled 1930s private bank office: large slate chalkboard on an easel or wall, mahogany desk, green banker's lamp, bookshelves of ledgers, a globe, framed certificates, tall window with soft light.
settings_library.modern_white_void: Clean bright off-white #FAFAF7 studio void with a thin black floor line; used only for modern/comedic contrast panels.
settings_library.sam_living_room_chalkboard: Warm vintage living room set for EP01: tan damask-dot wallpaper, crown moulding, a tall window with red curtains and a plant on the sill (left), dark-wood wainscoting, plank floor with an oval red rug, a cream-shaded floor lamp with warm glow, and a large wood-framed green chalkboard with a chalk tray filling the right wall.

accent_presets.profit_green_arrow: a single vivid profit-green (#2FA84F) upward arrow or bold green number
accent_presets.loss_red: bold loss-red (#D3302F) downward arrow, red numbers or red crayon scribbles
accent_presets.gold_seal: a shiny embossed gold (#C9A13B) foil seal
accent_presets.chalk_highlight: one circled number in bright chalk-white with a green underline
accent_presets.none: no extra accent color; keep the scene fully in the warm earthy palette
